It's the ranking system. To put it into perspective, the ranks from the bottom to the top are:

  • Silver
  • Gold
  • Platinum
  • Diamond
  • Master
  • Challenger

All rankings are divided further into five divisions, that is, for the Silver rank, there would be, from bottom to top,:

  • Silver V
  • Silver IV
  • Silver III
  • Silver II
  • Silver I

except for Challenger because they're ranked according to the highest number of ranking points with quota, also known as LP or League Points.
There are different leagues in the game (bronze, silver, gold, diamond, etc.), players with a higher winrate than 50 percent move up and players with a lower one move down.
